column7:
Positioning MATTERS! Speed priority goes from Front to Back in a Left to Right fashion.
For. e.g. If all heroes have the same speed, the speed attack of heroes will proceed in the same numbering you see in the formation label.
If a hero on the right frontline has the same speed as both heroes in the backline, the hero in the front will go first, then those in the back and then the other 2 with lower speed.

The relationship between Gears & Accessories is flexible. Whichever combination is easier to hit near 100%, use that.
For e.g., If you have better Crit Rolls on your gears, then accessory can have Weakness Hit Chance instead and vice versa. 
If you can achieve both well with gears alone, then accessory can boost other 1-3 Target Atk DMG instead (IDEAL).

Stats from ACC, EE, PASSIVE & ALLY will only be applied in battle and is not reflected on the hero's stats details.
